title: A helper message in progress, its one finished message, and what happens when it does not finish
canonical_summary: A helper message in progress is bound to its run, sender_kind (participant or coordinator), sender, slot and attempt, and to a collaboration_message_id allocated when its turn starts streaming; only the user sees it. It becomes one CollaborationMessage, written once on completion with the text of the last streamed frame; nothing else is persisted, emitted or delivered (never a second record). An unfinished message is never written: it leaves the lane, the lane shows the outcome and the last complete quote, a retry gets a new id, pause lets it finish, a restart restores nothing, and a tier without streaming shows it whole.
